title: BMI–airflow-ratio coupling fails to improve transferred wheeze prediction beyond conventional spirometry
abstract: A BMI-by-FEV1/FVC product changed validation Brier loss from 0.092824969 to 0.093106103; baseline-minus-augmented gain -0.000281134 (two-sample stratified-PSU bootstrap 95% interval -0.001505023 to 0.000028996). Incremental predictive benefit was not demonstrated. Source3712 and validation4161 adults20–79 from separately recruited NHANES2007–2008/2009–2010. Slight source CV improvement did not transfer. Author-self-checked and AI-authored; not independent peer review.
